div.head: I As 1
div.ab: ⁊ ic wille, þæt biscopas ⁊ þa gerefan hit beodan eallum þam þe him hiran sculon, þæt hit to ðam rihtan andagan gelæst sy.
⁊ ic wille, þæt biscopas ⁊ þa gerefan hit beodan eallum þam þe him hyran scylan, ⁊ þæt hit to þam rihtan andagan gelæst sy.

⁊ ic wille, þæt mine bisceopes ⁊ gereafa ðæs demaþ eallum ðe hio gehyrsumian gebyraþ, ⁊ þæt ilce to ðam tide fulfremaþ ðe we hio settaþ, ⁊ ðæs sie to ðæm dæg ðær beheafdunges scint Iohannes þæs fulhteres.
Et uolo, ut episcopi mei et prepositi hoc iudicent omnibus, qui eis parere debent, et hoc ad terminum expleant quem eis ponimus, id est Decollatio sancti Iohannis baptiste.
Ic wille, þæt [mine] biscopas ⁊ þa gerefan hit beodan eallum þam þe him hyran scylan, ⁊ þæt hit to þam rihtan andagan gelæst sy [⁊ ðæs sie to ðæm dæg ðær beheafdunges seint Iơhannes þæs fulhteres].
And ic wille þæt biscopas and þa gerefan hit beodan eallum þam þe him hyran scylan, and þæt hit to þam rihtan andagan gelæst sy.

And I desire my bishops and the reeves to give this order to all those whose duty it is to obey them, and that it [the payment] be rendered on the legally-appointed day; and that shall be the day on which Saint John the Baptist was beheaded.
And I direct the bishops and reeves to convey this command to those who must obey them, and that the tithes are to be rendered on the lawfully appointed day.

Und ich will, dass (meine lq) Bischöfe und die Vögte es gebieten (dies zuerkennen lq) allen denen, welche ihnen zu gehorchen verpflichtet sind, und dass es zum gesetzlichen Termin geleistet werde (und dass sie selbiges vollziehen zu der Zeit, die wir ihnen ansetzen, und dies sei zum Tage der Enthauptung s. Johannes des Täufers lq).

And I will that (my, lq) bishops and the reeves command it (adjudge this, lq) to all those who are bound to obey them, and that it be performed by the lawful term (and that they carry it out at the time which we set for them, and this is to be by the day of the Beheading of St John the Baptist, lq).
div.note: Liebermann adds ‘mine’ from Ld and Quadr., and ‘⁊’ before ‘þæt hit’ from G, Ld and Quadr.
